hypotheses.justification: IsFinite h implies LocallyOfFiniteType h, and locallyOfFiniteType_comp gives LocallyOfFiniteType (h ≫ fY). Replace exists_algebra_finiteType fX by exists_algebra_finiteType (h ≫ fY); the remaining proof is unchanged. No compatibility between fX and fY is needed. The chosen affine opens remain nonempty because they contain x and h.base x.

On the chosen affine opens write B = Γ(Y,V), A = Γ(X,h ⁻¹ᵁ V), and I = ker φ. A remains a domain. Surjectivity of h implies every prime of B contains I. Replace B by B/I: this is a finite-type K-domain, and the induced map B/I → A is integral and injective. Apply the existing height_comap_eq to that map. Quotienting by I preserves all prime heights, since Ideal.primeSpectrumQuotientOrderIsoZeroLocus identifies Spec(B/I) with all of Spec(B); use PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight and Order.height_orderIso. The existing stalk-localization argument then finishes. This includes nonreduced Y; x ensures both affine opens are nonempty.
